layer_2_setting.tray_structure: STRICT 3-WELL RIGID PLASTIC. Large vertical well on the left. Two small stacked wells on the right. The tray is empty of paper and metal.
layer_2_setting.ui_layout: A white paper napkin sits on the white floor OUTSIDE the tray, to the bottom-right. On the napkin sits one red fork and one red spoon. Blue translucent glass of water OUTSIDE the tray to the top-right.

layer_3_action.large_well: Tall, upright stalks of green horsetail plants. They are arranged vertically to fit the well, rendered with a smooth plastic toy texture.
layer_3_action.top_right_well: A cluster of vibrant yellow fan-shaped ginkgo leaves.
layer_3_action.bottom_right_well: A small mound of soft, puffy green moss.

app_image_config.negative_constraints: No 4-well trays, no 5-well trays, no realistic plants, no camera zoom-out, no extra dividers.
